summary: Fenbo Holdings filed a 6-K disclosing that directors Wang Zhiyong and Zhang Peng resigned from the board effective August 19, 2026, with no disagreement cited, and an entirely new board and officer slate was appointed the same day. Huang Hongwu now serves as CEO, President, COO, Executive Director and Chairman; Wang Xuefei as CFO, Treasurer, Secretary and Executive Director; Li Siu Lun Allan as Executive Director; and Li Xiang, Wu Qiuxia, Liu Zhenyu and Dai Lei as independent directors. No terms, advisors or shareholder votes were disclosed. The near-total board reconstitution and concentration of titles warrants watching for governance and control signals.
